people.her: a young woman with long damp dark red hair with a strand of green river weed in it, bare arms, a fitted leather and steel armoured bodice with round steel pauldrons, a sword and a round shield
people.warden: the Ford-Warden, a hooded drowned giant nearly three times a man's height, a long beard heavy with river water and weed, two points of cold blue light for eyes deep under the hood, a greatsword in his right hand, and in his left fist a lamp that is a square cage of new black forged iron with a cold pale blue flame
people.ford: a shallow stony river ford at night with thick mist lying on the water, iron lamp posts burning with cold pale blue flames
people.drowned: rows of drowned dead villagers standing waist deep in the dark water, soaked, weed hanging on them, heads bowed

shots.1: medium long shot from behind {her} standing at the water's edge beside an iron lamp post with a cold pale blue flame at frame left, looking north across {ford}; to the right, in a deep pool, one huge gauntleted arm stands straight up out of the river holding a square black iron lamp with a cold pale blue flame clear of the water
shots.2: wide shot at water level across a dark misty pool: {drowned}, facing away from camera in ragged rows, utterly still in moving mist; in the middle distance a single huge arm stands up out of the water holding a lamp with a cold pale blue flame
shots.3: extreme close-up insert: an ancient armoured gauntlet black with river slime and grown with weed, gripping a lamp that is a square cage of clean new black forged iron with sharp unrusted edges and a cold pale blue flame inside; the dark water surface below trembling in rings
shots.4: close-up of {her} listening, very still, head tilted, eyes on something out in the river; cold pale blue light on her face from the side, mist behind her
shots.5: low wide shot just above the water: {warden} rising up out of the river, water sheeting off his hood and beard, sitting up like a drowned man and then standing, towering taller than the lamp posts, the lamp held high and clear of the water; mist
shots.6: medium shot, the camera backing away ahead of him: {warden} wading through the ford toward camera, his greatsword dragging through the water and on the stones behind him, the blue lamp in his left fist lighting the mist
shots.7: profile two-shot: {warden} bending a long way down over {her} and lifting his blue iron lamp to her face, the way a gatekeeper inspects a traveller; she holds her shield up between them and does not step back; his lamp arm trembling
shots.8: extreme close-up of {her} face lit by a cold pale blue lamp very close: the small blue flame reflected in each of her eyes, wet hair, a strand of green river weed caught in the light; her lips parted and no breath showing at all in the cold; faint ember red on the other side of her face
shots.9: low angle close-up looking up past a square black iron lamp with a cold pale blue flame at {warden}: his face under the deep hood lit from below, the beard streaming with water, two points of cold blue light for eyes
shots.10: low wide shot on the water from behind a giant's legs looking down a misty pool: {drowned}, all turning their heads at once toward camera in a wave down the rows
shots.11: low wide shot from the riverbank of the whole ford: {warden} standing in the river facing {her} on the near bank; the cold blue flames of the three lamp posts all leaning toward him at once like grass in a wind; ice spreading out across the black water from each post; {drowned} lifting their heads
shots.12: medium shot pulling up and back: {warden} setting his guard with the greatsword in the ford, {her} small before him with shield raised, the blue lamps and the mist around them
